relationships.subject: DKK3
relationships.evidence_quote: rDKK3 could significantly alleviate the increased level of p-ASK-1 in the spinal cord induced by nerve injury compared with the SNI + Vehicle group

relationships.subject: DKK3
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicate that rDKK3 can markedly attenuate established mechanical allodynia in SNI rats, and also delayed the development of mechanical allodynia in SNI rats.

relationships.subject: DKK3
relationships.evidence_quote: we found that rDKK3 prevented SNI-induced M1 microglial polarization and promoted the M2 phenotype

relationships.subject: DKK3
relationships.evidence_quote: rDKK3 could reverse the up-regulated levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines including IL-1β (Additional file 3: Fig. S3a), IL-6 (Additional file 3: Fig. S3b), and TNF-α

relationships.subject: Kremen-1
relationships.evidence_quote: rDKK3 alleviated mechanical allodynia induced by nerve injury compared with SNI + Vehicle group, but this effect was abolished by Kremen-1 siRNA or DVL-1 siRNA

key_findings: DKK3, Kremen-1 and DVL-1 are reduced in spinal cord after SNI; intrathecal rDKK3 relieves allodynia, inhibits p-ASK1/p-JNK/p-p38 and shifts microglia M1 to M2.
Kremen-1 or DVL-1 siRNA abolishes rDKK3 analgesia.
